thread:
emily: Quick follow-up from the late-night throughput incident. Short: heavy client fanout + delayed scale-up caused sustained p95 breaches on /batching and burned ~19% of route error budget in ~22m. Need owners for remediation, dashboards, and a scoped temporary SLO change.
rajesh: I'll take infra remediation. Hypothesis: autoscaler scale-up window + large max_batch_size created head-of-line delay. Plan: lower max_batch_size, lower queue threshold for scaling, and add faster warmup. Will open PR today.
sara: I'll own observability and alerts. Actions: add per-pool queue_depth gauge, error-budget burn-rate panel, and a p99 heatmap. Also add an alert for sustained p95 > 450ms for 10m on /batching. PR by tomorrow AM.
emily: For SLO change propose scoping to /batching only: P95 from 300ms -> 520ms for 48h starting at prod rollout. Must include rollback predicate: if burn-rate > 200% over rolling 15m, revert SLO and page. Thoughts?
rajesh: Agree on rollback predicate. 48h ok if tied to canary success. I'll add canary job with synthetic vectors to measure p95/p99 pre/post.
sara: Noted recurring pattern: spikes tied to pod churn during rolling updates. I'll tag autoscaler events in traces and add a panel. Also include per-client top offenders to help throttle noisy tenants.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0320-11 created — linked postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-20-throughput-spike
emily: Owner recap: rajesh -> infra PR + canary orchestration; sara -> dashboards/alerts + trace tagging; emily -> SLO doc + compliance request + schedule sync. Timeline: infra proposal by EOD, staging canary within 24h, prod rollout + SLO window aligned with rollout. Sync at 20:00 UTC to review canary.
rajesh: starting infra tests now, will post diffs here. :rocket:
sara: ping me for quick review, will prioritize. :eyes:
ops-bot: Canary safety policy: auto-rollback enabled. If p95 > 600ms for >10m during canary, rollback will trigger automatically.
emily: Thanks all. Short checklist: [rajesh] infra PR, [sara] dashboard PR, [emily] SLO doc + compliance filing. We'll reconvene after canary.
